Sky-Watcher Heritage 150P

6 inches of tabletop Dobsonian — the sweet spot starter scope.

around $300

A 150mm collapsible Dobsonian that sits on a table or stool and shows you Saturn's rings, Jupiter's bands and hundreds of deep-sky objects. The most recommended first real telescope in the hobby for a reason: huge views, tiny price, zero setup fuss.

Why we like it

  • 150mm aperture punches far above its price
  • Collapsible tube fits in a car boot
  • Simple Dobsonian base — point and look

Keep in mind

  • Needs a sturdy table or stool
  • No tracking — planets drift
  • Collimation needed occasionally
